Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

We’re looking for a hands-on security leader who can build, manage, and scale Pointsville’s security and compliance programs. This role is ideal for someone capable of designing enterprise-grade security programs, engineering security tools, and embedding best practices into fast-moving development environments.

What You’ll Do

Security Strategy, Leadership & Program Development

  • Build and lead Pointsville’s global security and compliance function from the ground up.
  • Develop and implement the company-wide security strategy, policies, and frameworks aligned with business and regulatory goals.
  • Conduct organization-wide risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and incident response exercises.
  • Drive security awareness and training programs to strengthen company-wide accountability.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure security goals align with organizational priorities.

Technical Security Engineering

  • Lead the design and development of advanced security testing and monitoring platforms, including distributed fuzzing systems and validation frameworks.
  • Conduct secure architecture reviews and threat modeling for infrastructure, APIs, smart contracts, and cloud-native services.
  • Integrate Secure SDLC practices into CI/CD pipelines — automating vulnerability discovery, testing, and compliance reporting.
  • Perform deep-dive analysis of vulnerabilities, exploits, and mitigations across web, mobile, and blockchain systems.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to ensure secure-by-design implementation in infrastructure-as-code and deployments.

Cloud, Infrastructure & Data Protection

  • Oversee cloud security architecture (AWS preferred), including network segmentation, IAM, and continuous monitoring.
  • Manage VPNs, multi-region access, and secret management tools (Vault, KMS, etc.).
  • Ensure data privacy and protection measures are embedded in all systems and products.
  • Lead investigations, containment, and response in the event of security incidents or data breaches.

Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Develop and maintain security compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, and CCPA.
  • Prepare and manage internal and external audits and certifications.
  • Identify, document, and mitigate enterprise security and compliance risks.
  • Establish a “privacy by design” and “security by default” culture in collaboration with legal and product teams.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Serve as the main point of contact for all internal and external security and compliance matters.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Operations to align security controls with business needs.
  • Deliver clear reporting and recommendations to leadership on security posture, incidents, and ongoing improvements.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, product security, or infrastructure security roles.
  • Proven track record designing and deploying security tools and frameworks at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cryptography, secure protocols, and key management systems.
  • Expertise in AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of application security (OWASP, STRIDE, TARA) and vulnerability mitigation.
  • Proficiency in one or more system languages (Java, C, C++, Rust, Go) and one scripting language (Python, Shell).
  • Experience with blockchain and smart contract security preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate security controls, conduct penetration testing, and perform design reviews.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers and influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in written and spoken English

We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

description:

title: Safety, Environment & Healthy Coordinator
description:
Somos PepsiCo

Junte-se à PepsiCo e Ouse Transformar! Somos o lugar perfeito para pessoas curiosas, pensadoras e agentes de mudança. Desde o frontline até a nossa liderança, estamos entusiasmados(as) com o futuro e trabalhamos em equipe para tornar o mundo um lugar melhor.

Fazer parte da PepsiCo significa fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de alimentos e bebidas do mundo, com nossas marcas icônicas sendo consumidas mais de um bilhão de vezes por dia em mais de 200 países. No Brasil desde 1953, a PepsiCo possui marcas reconhecidas como QUAKER®, TODDY®, TODDYNHO®, ELMA CHIPS®, RUFFLES®, DORITOS®, EQLIBRI ™, GATORADE®, KERO COCO®, H2OH!®, PEPSI® e muitas outras.

Uma carreira na PepsiCo significa trabalhar em uma cultura onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas. Aqui, você pode ousar ser você. Não importa quem você seja, de onde você venha ou quem você ame, você sempre pode influenciar as pessoas ao seu redor e causar um impacto positivo no mundo.

Conheça um pouco mais sobre a PepsiCo: PepsiCoJobs

A oportunidade

Garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro e saudável para todos os colaboradores da planta de Feira de Santana (locais administrativos, Manufatura, Warehouse e etc.), atendendo a conformidade com todas as regulamentações ambientais e de saúde e segurança relacionadas à unidade, incluindo a implementação de políticas, procedimentos e sistema de gestão interno que visam prevenir acidentes, lesões ocupacionais e impactos ambientais.

Garantir o cumprimento dos objetivos, metas e indicadores definidos pela Pepsico e definir estratégias de atuação para a área e desenvolvimento da equipe.

O seu impacto

- Garantir o cumprimento da Política de Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança (SSMA) estabelecida;

- Liderar a equipe local de EHS;

- Garantir o cumprimento das normas locais, estaduais e federais de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente;

- Desenvolver e implementar programas de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente;

- Identificar e avaliar os riscos associados às operações da planta e do armazém, incluindo análises de risco de processo;

- Fornecer suporte e treinamento relacionados a EHS;

- Investigar incidentes de segurança, acidentes de trabalho e eventos ambientais para determinar as causas e implementar medidas de controle;

- Liderar a implementação e manutenção do sistema de gestão interno na fábrica;

- Gerenciar riscos e minimizar impactos relacionados às atividades, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e novas tecnologias e compartilhar as melhores práticas;

- Liderar inspeções e acompanhar visitas técnicas, inspeções e auditorias de órgãos públicos;

- Recomendar medidas de controle quanto ao grau de exposição a agentes agressivos de natureza física, química e biológica, caracterizando atividades, operações e locais insalubres e perigosos;

- Analisar e liderar a gestão de mudanças para instalações, máquinas, equipamentos e projetos da área de Engenharia;

- Especificar, controlar e supervisionar, garantindo a qualidade e a eficiência dos sistemas de proteção coletiva e Equipamentos de Segurança, incluindo equipamentos de proteção individual e equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio;

- Interagir ativamente junto aos Comitês Técnicos, principalmente liderando os programas sistêmicos visando a garantia das execuções;

- Apoiar a equipe de Engenharia durante o planejamento e execução de projetos de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente;

- Governar e gerenciar os indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) de EHS, criar planos para melhoria contínua e conformidade;

- Gerenciar o orçamento e o planejamento estratégico da área (Budget);

- Gestão do AOP (Annual Operating Plan);

- Desenvolver e apresentar os resultados de EHS à liderança e à operação;

- Implementar práticas e tecnologias sustentáveis para minimizar o impacto ambiental da operação da planta;

- Gerenciar o licenciamento da planta;

- Colaborar com outras áreas, como produção, manutenção e qualidade, para garantir a integração efetiva das práticas de EHS em todas as atividades;

- Conduzir campanhas, comunicações e programas de conscientização de EHS;

- Manter contato com agências reguladoras e acompanhar atividades de inspeção e fiscalização.

Quem estamos buscando?

  • Graduação em Engenharia com especialização em Engenharia de Segurança e Meio Ambiente;
  • Experiência sólida como líder em Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança (SSMA);
  • Sólido conhecimento do sistema de gestão de SSMA;
  • Auditor líder em ISO 14001, ISO 45001 e suas aplicabilidades;
  • Sólido conhecimento das regulamentações atuais de SSMA;
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Capacidade de desenvolvimento de talentos;
  • Habilidade desenvolvida em gerenciar dados e estatísticas de SSMA;
  • Habilidades eficazes de networking em uma região multinacional, multifuncional e com múltiplas unidades de negócios;
  • Idiomas: Inglês (experiente), Espanhol (experiente) desejável.
  • Expertise em plataformas de gestão de Requisitos Legais (ex. Sistema IUS Natura);
  • Auditor líder em sistemas de gestão de EHS;

Se esta é uma oportunidade que te interessa, te encorajamos a se candidatar mesmo que não atenda a 100% dos requisitos.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

  • Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.
  • Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico, para que você se mantenha sempre em seu melhor estado de saúde.
  • Com nosso benefício de Auto Executivo, você poderá escolher entre um carro, que inclui também ajuda com combustível e manutenção; ou um bônus de auxílio transporte (apenas para níveis gerenciais L10+).
  • Um programa de bem, com diferentes iniciativas ao longo do ano, que ajudará a promover mais equilíbri o para a sua saúde física, mental e integral -.
  • Programas que ajudarão a cuidar do seu bem-estar financeiro e a alcançar suas metas em todas as etapas da sua vida: Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro, Caixa de Poupança, Fundo de Poupança e Previdência Privada.
  • Adoramos celebrar o sucesso, por isso contamos com programas de reconhecimento por tempo de trabalho, comportamentos, liderança, momentos de vida, entre outros.
  • E como sua família também é importante para nós, estendemos benefícios como nossa Linha de Bem-Estar, Convênios e Descontos, programas de Bolsas de Estudo para seus/suas filhos(as), Planos de Auxílios para diferentes momentos de vida, entre outros.

Na PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos em promover uma equipe de trabalho diversa, criando um espaço colaborativo, equitativo e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de como nos parecemos, de onde viemos ou a quem amamos - tenham suas vozes ouvidas. Oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades e consideramos os(as) candidatos(as) para todos os cargos, sem distinção de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

title: Billing Specialist
description:
As a Billing Specialist, you will be crucial to our company's financial management, serving as a vital link between various departments and ensuring accuracy in our billing processes.

Detailed Responsibilities

Customer Billing Management:

  • Collect and verify billing information from multiple internal sources.
  • Generate accurate and detailed invoices using our ERP system.
  • Ensure all invoices comply with legal and tax requirements.
  • Manage billing discrepancies.

Vendor Invoice Processing:

  • Receive and process vendor invoices related to specific projects.
  • Verify invoice accuracy against purchase orders and contracts.
  • Request vendor payments according to agreed terms.

Project Tracking and Reporting:

  • Maintain up-to-date records of each project's financial status.
  • Generate monthly reports on billing progress by project.
  • Collaborate with controlling department to resolve financial discrepancies.

Monthly Closing and Reporting:

  • Prepare and reconcile accounts for monthly closing.
  • Generate detailed financial reports for management review.
  • Assist in preparing presentations for monthly closing meetings.
  • Analyze trends and propose improvements in billing processes.

Data and Systems Management:

  • Maintain accurate customer databases.
  • Continuously update and improve billing processes in the ERP system.
  • Ensure the integrity and confidentiality of financial data.
  • Propose and implement improvements to billing systems.

Interdepartmental Collaboration:

  • Work closely with the sales team to ensure timely billing.
  • Coordinate with the legal department to ensure contractual compliance.
  • Support the controlling team in financial analyses and internal audits.
  • Assist the customer service department with billing-related inquiries.

Professional Development and Continuous Improvement:

  • Stay updated on best practices in billing and finance.
  • Contribute ideas for process improvement and operational efficiency.
  • Mentor new team members as needed.

Profile Requirement

  • Proficiency in billing software and Microsoft Excel is a plus.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Exceptional organizational and time management skills.
  • Effective problem-solving abilities and a professional approach to handling customer inquiries and issues.
  • Knowledge of accounting principles and practices is advantageous.

What we offer

  • An international community bringing together 110+ different nationalities

title: Salesforce Administrator (Part-Time)
description:
We are looking for a part-time, remote Salesforce Administrator with 3-5 years of Salesforce administration experience to join our U.S. client's team. You will work 10 to 15 hours per week supporting the ongoing development, configuration, and management of Salesforce across the Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Service organizations. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, a keen analytical mind, and the ability to drive business outcomes through platform optimization and insightful data analysis.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).

Responsibilities

  • Partner with cross-organizational teams to gather requirements and deliver scalable solutions
  • Administer and maintain the Salesforce environment, ensuring data integrity, system stability, and optimal performance
  • Configure, customize, and maintain Salesforce objects, fields, workflows, validation rules, page layouts, and other settings to support business processes
  • Develop and maintain Salesforce Flows, reports, and dashboards to provide actionable insights and improve user productivity
  • Design and implement new features or system enhancements
  • Manage integrations between Salesforce and third-party platforms, ensuring data consistency and seamless functionality
  • Conduct testing, troubleshooting, and documentation for new configurations, automation, and system updates
  • Monitor and manage user accounts, roles, permissions, and security settings in accordance with company policies
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices; recommend improvements and lead adoption of new capabilities
  • Provide user support, training, and documentation for more effective system usage

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 3-5 years of experience as a Salesforce Administrator in enterprise, B2B environments
  • Proficiency in Salesforce setup and configuration
  • Solid understanding of CRM principles and Salesforce best practices
  • Experience in Sales Cloud and Salesforce Flow development, reporting, and dashboard creation
  • Experience with integration tools and third-party platforms
  • Ability to review, design, and test new features and customizations independently
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Commitment to continuous learning as well as staying current with platform updates
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, business, or a related field
  • Certification as a Salesforce Administrator or Sales Cloud Consultant

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. title: Business Account Representative
description:
We are looking for a Business Account Representative to play a key role in ensuring the continued success and satisfaction of our rapidly growing customer base.

Your Role

You will contribute to our clients’ success by:

  • Ensuring the satisfaction and retention of your client portfolio.
  • Onboarding suppliers and clients onto our platform to guarantee optimal use of our services.
  • Creating and validating new projects — verifying the correct configuration of supplier and client profiles, validating legal documents, and processing purchase orders.
  • Closely monitoring project renewals and managing purchase order receptions.
  • Maintaining strong alignment and collaboration with Account Managers.
  • Ensuring a seamless billing process through close coordination with the Finance team.
  • Continuously improving our sales administration processes by sharing feedback and ideas that enhance the value we deliver to clients.
  • Providing additional support when needed to meet business objectives.

About You

You are an enthusiastic, detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with people and solving problems.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

  • Strong interpersonal skills and a positive, proactive attitude.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English .
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in Customer Support, Account Management, or a related service field (preferably within digital products).
  • A degree in Communication, Management, IT, Business , or a similar field.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to manage complexity and pay close attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.

What we offer

  • An international community bringing together 110+ different nationalities
  • An environment where trust has a central place: 70% of our key leaders started their careers at the first level of responsibilities
  • A robust training system with our internal Academy and 250+ available modules
  • A vibrant workplace that frequently gathers for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.)
  • Strong commitments to CSR notably through participation in our WeCare Together program

Our Hiring Process

  • Short phone call with our talent acquisition team to discuss about your ambitions and how they align with Mantu's mission.
  • First interview with your future manager or director. In this interview you will know more about your role, your mission, the challenges, and the skills we value.
  • Second interview with a senior leader or your future teammates. This is the time to share what you've discovered about us and how thrilled you are to join us and how well we fit with your expectation.
  • Third with the department director. If we are a perfect match, this interview might just end with a job offer.

title: Oracle Cloud Field Service consultant

Job Specification: Oracle Cloud Field Service Consultant

Contract Role – Remote

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud Field Service (OFS) Consultant to support the design, configuration, optimization, and ongoing enhancement of our field service operations. This is a remote contract role suited for someone with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Field Service Cloud, with additional experience in Oracle Service Cloud (OSvC) and Oracle CPQ being highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the implementation, configuration, and customization of Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) to support business workflows, scheduling, routing, and mobile field operations.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable functional and technical solutions.
  • Configure OFS modules including capacity, activity management, work order orchestration, routing plans, and mobility experiences.
  • Integrate OFS with other Oracle cloud applications, especially Oracle Service Cloud , Oracle CPQ , and external systems via REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Perform solution testing, UAT support, documentation, and knowledge transfer to internal teams.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues, ensuring seamless field operations.
  • Recommend best practices and continuous improvements in field service processes.
  • Support deployment activities, including data migration, configuration promotion, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including service operations, IT, product management, and vendors.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) .
  • Strong understanding of OFS architecture, configuration frameworks, APIs, message scenarios, routing, and capacity planning.
  • Experience designing workflows, activity types, and policy configurations in OFS.
  • Ability to write and interpret OFS API integrations, business rules, and extensibility scripts.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements and convert them into actionable configuration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery environments.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

Desired Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with Oracle Service Cloud (RightNow/OSvC) configuration, workflows, and integrations.
  • Experience with Oracle CPQ (quoting workflows, commerce rules, integrations).
  • Understanding of broader Oracle CX Cloud architecture and integrations.
  • Experience with mobile workforce or field service applications outside Oracle.
  • Knowledge of cloud integration tools (OIC, Boomi, MuleSoft, etc.).

title: Product Designer
description:
About the Company

Hi, we’re Actabl. We’re providing better solutions for hotel companies as the world around us evolves and changes related to using technology, finding labor, and maximizing profits. Our mission is to empower the people that power hospitality. We give hoteliers actionable insights to know what to do, the tools to do it, and the visibility to know it worked. We bring together powerful hospitality tech solutions to maximize profits for more than 10,000 properties in hospitality markets around the world.

Our Valued Behaviors

  • Start with People: We are in the hospitality business and hospitality starts with people. This impacts both our being and our doing.
  • Being: We are responsible for building relationships, earning trust, and having fun. These things are fundamental to hospitality.
  • Doing: We will succeed if we start with great people working as one team. Empower others, speak the truth with care, and go together.
  • Demand Integrity: Be trustworthy, be ethical, and be consistent whether someone is watching or not. Demand integrity of yourself and others to build the fabric of a high-integrity organization.
  • Delight the Customer: We aim to delight our customers in the same way our customers aim to delight their guests. The question is not if completed a process or hit a metric, the question is whether or not the customer is delighted.
  • Champion Innovation: We compete in the game of change and win through innovation. Think big and then think bigger when it comes to the innovation required to tackle the problems our customers face daily.
  • Make it Happen: We show up prepared, care about the details, and follow through. Don't get distracted. Don't stop at blockers. Don't make excuses. Find a way and drive until it is done.

About Actabl's Product Design Team

We redefine expectations

We treat SaaS with the same passion and craft you’d expect from world-class consumer products. Our mission is to redefine what hospitality teams can expect from their tools by delivering thoughtful, high-quality experiences and pushing the product forward step by step, with real impact.

Bellhop Design System

Our young design system is called Bellhop because it was inspired by the essence of hospitality. It's a scalable and cohesive system made to empower people who power hospitality. Check out .

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end design across features and flows, from discovery to delivery.
  • Collaborate with PMs and engineers to shape problem spaces, define requirements, and validate solutions.
  • Design intuitive, scalable interfaces for enterprise SaaS products with heavy use of dashboards, complex data tables, and operational workflows .
  • Run user interviews, synthesize insights, and convert them into actionable design decisions.
  • Produce high-quality UI/UX deliverables: journeys, wireframes, flows, high-fidelity screens, prototypes, tables, dashboards, etc.
  • Work closely with our design system team to maintain consistency and push our standards forward.
  • Advocate for user experience and influence decision-making across cross-functional teams.
  • Incorporate AI tools, Vibe Coding, and rapid prototyping into your process to increase velocity and quality.
  • Understand our products, personas, their journeys, and JTBD.

You as a Product Designer

Ideal Profile

You are not a “by the books” Product Designer and have at least 3 years of experience, strong design craft, and excellent communication skills. You are comfortable with high-density enterprise SaaS interfaces such as dashboards and data grids, and you work confidently with design systems and cross-functional teams.

  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Designer (UX/UI) in tech or SaaS companies.
  • Portuguese and English is mandatory
  • Living in Brazil.
  • Strong product thinking, ability to break down complexity, understand constraints, frame problems, and propose pragmatic solutions.
  • Excellent English communication (major stakeholders are native english speakers)
  • Solid experience designing for enterprise SaaS applications.
  • Comfortable crafting elegant high-density interfaces.
  • Experience working with design systems (tokens, components, libraries).
  • Strong craft with an attention to detail.
  • Portfolio demonstrating clear thinking, strong fundamentals, and high-quality craft.'

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI prototyping tools (e.g., Figma Make, V0, Claude Code).
  • Experience integrating AI into design workflows.
  • Familiarity with hospitality, operational tools, or B2B workflows.

Work Environment:

Location: Full-remote Brasil.

Connectivity: Requires a reliable internet connection and a suitable home office setup.

Equipment: The company provides necessary equipment (laptop, monitor, peripherals).

Travel: Occasional travel may be required. A valid driver's license may be required for travel.

Work Hours: Employees are expected to be available during core business hours to ensure collaboration with team members and stakeholders.

Communication: Regular communication via video calls, chat applications, and email is expected.

Additional Information

  • Full-remote job position
  • You will be hired as a contractor (PJ)

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone. 
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional. 

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others. 

Who you are 

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package 
  • Paid Time Off 
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate’s education, experience, skills and potential.
Hunter Douglas is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

Otimizar fluxos de processamento de dados visando custo e performance.

Aplicar boas práticas de CI/CD, versionamento e Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) em pipelines de dados.

Assegurar conformidade com normas de segurança, governança e privacidade (ex.: PII, GDPR, LGPD).

Experiência comprovada em engenharia de dados, com foco em construção de pipelines.

Domínio em SQL, Python e Spark.

Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (Google Cloud Platform, AWS ou Azure).

Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem de dados, data warehouse e arquiteturas lake/lakehouse.

Conhecimentos em containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

Vivência com pipelines de machine learning e MLOps.

Experiência com catálogos de dados, metadata management e ferramentas de governança.

Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.

Capacidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara a públicos não técnicos.

Trabalho em equipe, postura proativa e colaborativa.

We are creating a pool of Junior and Senior Non Key Expert for EU-Circular Economy and Water Facility project . Experts in this pool will be contacted during the implementation of the project when the need arise. If you have relevant experience, we encourage you to apply.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
We are looking for a high-performing Full Stack Engineer with strong experience in both Python (backend) and React (frontend) to join our client’s distributed engineering team in Brazil. This role is ideal for someone who excels at building clean, scalable APIs and intuitive user interfaces while collaborating with product, design, and engineering stakeholders.

You will be responsible for developing end-to-end features, improving system architecture, and supporting the evolution of a modern tech stack powering mission-critical applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Python (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • Develop responsive, user-friendly front-end applications using React, Typescript, and modern UI frameworks.
  • Implement RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs and integrate them with internal and external systems.
  • Work closely with product managers and UX/UI designers to translate requirements into high-quality code.
  • Optimize performance across front-end and back-end components.
  • Manage databases and data models (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, etc.).
  • Contribute to overall system architecture, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
  • Write automated tests (unit, integration, end-to-end) to maintain code quality.
  • Collaborate in an agile environment with remote teams across Brazil.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–7+ years of experience as a Full Stack Engineer or Software Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python and popular backend frameworks (FastAPI preferred, Flask, Django).
  • Professional experience with React and Typescript (Hooks, Context, Redux, or similar).
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs or GraphQL services.
  • Strong understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases.
  • Experience deploying applications using cloud services ( AWS, GCP, or Azure ).
  • Solid grasp of software architecture, design patterns, and version control (Git).
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment with clear communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized deployments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI).
  • Exposure to microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with testing frameworks (PyTest, Jest, Cypress, etc.).
  • Experience working with Brazilian or international distributed engineering teams.

title: Data Research Analyst
description:
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 3-5 years of data analysis and reporting experience
  • Advanced experience writing and creating large-scale surveys (QuestionPro, Qualtrics), analyzing results/data, and developing actionable findings
  • Experience with Tableau for data visualization
  • Experience in writing detailed reports and presenting data findings/analysis.

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Passion for video games/gaming in order to assist in writing and interpreting survey questions
  • Experience with SQL writing data queries
  • Snowflake or Data Bricks experience

Insight Global is hiring a Data Research Analyst to support the User Experience Research team at a leading company in the Gaming industry. The main role of the Data Research Analyst will be to create, send, and analyze large-scale surveys intended to learn about the player base of the core gaming products.

Job Functions

-Create surveys and trackers to support all products and initiatives

  • Design questions that do not bias respondents
  • Use best practice methodologies to produce actionable, accurate, and representative data.

-Advanced, survey focused, data visualizations (Tableau, Excel, Sheets)

  • Creating clear reports and dashboards based on surveys sent to players and users of their products.

-Data queries (HIVE, Snowflake, Tableau)

  • Querying multiple types of databases and plugging data queries directly into tools like Tableau are essential for this role. These skills will be used to target audiences for survey sends, pull in additional analytics to identify respondents, and allow for advanced data visualizations.

-Report writing and presenting data

  • Writing detailed and understandable reports that will speak to a variety of audiences across the enterprise
  • Presenting data in meetings and providing additional relevant context where applicable.

-Act as backup for all functions of current data researchers

-Provide support to UX researchers on report creation that involves data visualization.

-Quickly pivot with new data to ensure a constant flow of player insights are output as updated player survey data is received to ensure we are always reporting on timely and relevant findings.

-Contribute to overall needs of the UXR team e.g. peer review, supporting other teams with survey expertise, etc.

-Contribute survey expertise to assist others in the company with the creation of surveys.

title: Coordenador fiscal - Torre de faturamento
description:
Briefing da posição:

Como Coordenador/Supervisor Fiscal da Torre de Faturamento, o profissional será responsável por liderar a operação fiscal vinculada ao faturamento da empresa (“torre” de faturamento), assegurando o correto processamento de notas fiscais, apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos, cumprimento de obrigações acessórias, e a entrega de resultados por meio de KPIs.

Espera-se perfil de liderança, domínio técnico e capacidade de interface executiva (internamente com Financeiro, Faturamento, Contabilidade, Comercial, e externamente com clientes). O inglês avançado será requisito para interação com equipes globais ou clientes internacionais.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Coordenar as atividades da torre de faturamento: emissão e conferência de notas fiscais (saídas/entradas), conferência de faturamento, retenções, XML, NFS-e/NF-e, CTe, etc.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de obrigações acessórias: SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, DCTF, EFD-Contribuições, REINF, ECF/ECD, etc;
  • Implantar e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) da operação fiscal/faturamento (por exemplo: % de notas com erro fiscal, tempo de processamento, custo por nota, índice de credits fiscais aproveitados, SLA de faturamento, conformidade) e reportar à liderança executiva;
  • Desenvolver e liderar a equipe da torre (coordenados e analistas), promovendo treinamento, engajamento, definição de metas, monitoramento de performance e melhorias contínuas de processo;
  • Interface com Financeiro, Contabilidade, Comercial/Vendas, TI/ERP e auditoria, assegurando que as operações de faturamento estejam alinhadas aos controles internos, aos requisitos de compliance e às estratégias de negócio;
  • Liderar ou participar de iniciativas de melhoria de processos, automação, mapeamento de riscos fiscais, aproveitamento de créditos, e adaptação a mudanças da legislação (como reforma tributária, por exemplo) ou cenários de negócio;
  • Apresentar análises gerenciais e relatórios executivos (em inglês, quando for o caso) à alta direção ou matriz, com propostas de ação, acompanhamento de metas e suportes decisórios.

Qualificações & requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Preferencialmente com registro CRC ativo (quando aplicável);
  • Experiência sólida em operação fiscal/tributária, com apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos em ambiente corporativo;
  • Experiência comprovada em faturamento ou faturamento tributário (emissão de notas fiscais, retenções, faturamento em operação com produtos/serviços) e liderança de equipe;
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito) – para reportes, interface com clientes estrangeiros;
  • Perfil forte de liderança, com habilidades executivas — comunicação clara, capacidade de influenciar, visibilidade junto à diretoria, visão de negócio;
  • Familiaridade com KPIs, dashboards, relatórios gerenciais, e métricas de performance da área fiscal/faturamento;
  • Atuação em ambiente de alta demanda, com foco em prazos, entregas, auditorias e mudanças regulatórias;

Competências comportamentais:

  • Visão estratégica com mindset operacional (“hands-on”);
  • Alta capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes;
  • Orientação para resultados e melhoria contínua;
  • Excelente comunicação (com a equipe, stakeholders e diretoria);
  • Adaptabilidade e proatividade para lidar com mudanças rápidas (ex: reforma tributária, nova legislação);
  • Integridade, postura ética e foco em compliance;

Se você é um líder fiscal com visão estratégica, domínio técnico e capacidade de transformar operações através de performance, governança e indicadores, esta posição pode ser a oportunidade ideal para direcionar resultados com impacto direto no negócio.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant

Remote – Brazil

*Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.

Company Overview

Sphise is a global outsourcing partner, helping international companies build and manage high-performing teams worldwide.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Accountant to join their dynamic team.

Position Overview

As a Senior Accountant, you will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy and operational excellence across our international finance team. You will take ownership of complex reconciliations, advanced transaction coding, and key components of the month-end close, contributing directly to the integrity of our financial reporting.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online; identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  2. Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  3. Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules; contribute to month-end close processes.
  4. Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance; provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  5. Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  6. Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries; maintain supporting documentation.
  7. Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  8. Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules; serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  9. Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.

Qualifications

  1. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  2. Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  3. Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  4. Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  5. Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  6. Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.

Preferred Experience

  1. 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  2. Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  3. Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  4. Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  5. Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  6. Strong English Skills.

Benefits:

  1. Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  2. Flexible work environment.
  3. Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Cabotage Coordinator
description:
Cabotage Coordinator

Job Title: Cabotage Coordinator

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Terms: Full Time. On site.

Compensation: Commensurate with experience, the individual’s, and the team’s performance.

Company:

Sky Fusion Global Supply Chain focus on global dry bulk shipping and Industrial Projects Logistics. Headquartered in Singapore, we have settled filiales in China, Morocco, South Africa, Australia, Brazil, USA, Germany, and continues to be a globally expanding group.

Our Core Business:

  • Global Dry Bulk Freight
  • Industrial Projects Logistics & Renewable Energy Supply Chain Innovation

For more information, you may check our website：

Role

Sky Fusion is seeking the right candidate to fill a key role, the new Cabotage Coordinator. The primary focus of this role is the coordination of bids for Brazilian Flag impelled cargo opportunities. These are cargoes that will move within the Brazilian territory.

The coordinator will be tasked with evaluating and pursuing both commercial and operational cargoes for carriage on the Company’s Brazil Flag vessels. The scope of these cargo bids may often require extension of the scope to include use of multimodal forms of conveyance.

Candidates are encouraged to think outside of the box. There are always new challenges on the horizon and ways to improve, even in a business as old as shipping.

This position will challenge the coordinator to come up with creative solutions by matching multiple fleet schedules and modes of transportation with various bids. This role will require constant interaction and communication with the Client’s team to ensure the successful execution of projects.

Responsibilities & Duties

a. Identification and pursuit of chartering opportunities for wind projects.

b. Voyage calculations and pricing of both near‐term and long‐term project cargoes.

c. Analysis of intermodal bids (commercial).

d. Administration of quoting system. Emphasis on visibility within team and timely communications with

customers.

e. Project monitoring

f. Tracking Wind Cargo Flows (Historic & Projected)

Requirements & Skills

a. Ability to multi‐task

b. Understanding of terms and conditions for contracts of carriage and carriage of breakbulk cargoes under Brazilian Cabotage legistlation.

c. Strong verbal and written communication skills

d. Attention to detail.

e. Minimum of bachelor’s degree (preferably in a Maritime Business Administration or Transportation).

f. Minimum three (3) years of experience in the Fluvial / Caoastal cabotage transportation industry is preferred but candidates with les experience will still receive consideration.

Personal Characteristics

Ambitious | Enthusiastic | Team player

description:
Responsibilities：

Based on architecture standards set by the headquarters IT architecture team, test and validate local products, drive procurement execution, and complete device purchases.

Manage local system integration projects to ensure effective implementation of solutions as guided by headquarters' technical requirements, while optimizing execution according to local needs.

Develop and implement localized IT solutions. Ensure IT infrastructure maintenance and operations align with headquarters standards.

Monitor the quality of office network using tools provided by headquarters IT, gather user feedback, and design and implement corresponding improvements.

Track, manage, and Inventory local IT infrastructure resources (including equipment inventories and supplier collaboration) and resolve local application and service issues, and ensure the integrity of IT infrastructure.

Provide standard operating procedures and documentation support, regularly reporting progress on localized solutions to headquarters.

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, IT-related fields, or Engineering.

At least 3 years of experience in IT network and data center system integration maintenance.

Proficiency in network and system monitoring tools (e.g. Zabbix, Grafana) and experience in operations automation tools.

Experience in managing CCTV, access control systems, facial recognition devices, and UPS systems is preferred.

Familiarity with key brands of switches, wireless APs, cameras, access control systems, racks and cables, with knowledge of their strengths and weaknesses.

Proven experience in developing and implementing IT solutions, with the ability to optimize execution based on practical requirements.

Strong communication and collaboration skills to effectively work with suppliers and headquarters IT teams.

Fluency in both Chinese and English, or Portuguese and English, for effective communication is preferred.

Possession of relevant technical certifications (e.g. CCIE) or project management certifications (e.g. PMP) is an advantage.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Our Mission At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are. Who We Are We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included. As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few! Job Description Your Career The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention. You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies. Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio. Your Impact
  • As a Regional Sales Manager, you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors
  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments
  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks
  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory
  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting
Qualifications Your Experience
  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context
  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts
  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)
  • Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction
  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals
Additional Information The Team Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients. As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step. Our Commitment We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Sobre a posição

Buscamos um(a) profissional apaixonado por tecnologia e inovação, com experiência em desenvolvimento de software e soluções de Inteligência Artificial, para atuar no desenvolvimento e implementação de soluções no nosso negócio.

O desafio é criar soluções escaláveis e inteligentes que otimizem a performance dos sistemas, fortaleçam a integração entre plataformas e contribuam diretamente para o crescimento sustentável do negócio.

O que irá fazer:

• Desenvolver e implementar soluções de conectividade (IoT, MVNO e VOIP) com foco em IA e automação de processos;

• Analisar e resolver problemas técnicos complexos, identificando causa raiz e propondo soluções eficazes;

• Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções tecnológicas;

• Desenvolver e acompanhar esteiras de projetos com IA, chatbots e agentes digitais (financeiro, atendimento etc.);

• Monitorar e otimizar continuamente a performance dos sistemas;

• Documentar processos, procedimentos e soluções técnicas, garantindo escalabilidade e manutenção;

• Acompanhar tendências de IA, Cloud e conectividade, trazendo inovações para os projetos.

O que precisa ter:

• Superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Computação/Software, Sistemas de Informação ou ADS. Pós-graduação ou especialização em IA será um diferencial.

• Idiomas: Inglês intermediário a avançado (documentação e reuniões).

• Experiência com desenvolvimento Fullstack e participação em esteiras de projetos de Inteligência Artificial, especialmente relacionados a chatbots e agentes digitais.

Conhecimentos em:

• Desenvolvimento Fullstack com C# e .NET;

• Cloud (Azure – preferencial, AWS);

• Web Services (REST, SOAP);

• Banco de dados SQL (MySQL, SQL Server);

• Experiência com Python ou PHP será diferencial;

• Docker, DevOps e GitFlow;

• IDEs de mercado (VSCode, JetBrains);

• Desejável: MLOps, NLP, Data Lakes e integrações com APIs

Diferenciais

• Inglês avançado;

• Certificação Azure em Desenvolvimento;

• Experiência prática em projetos de IA (NLP, visão computacional, recomendação personalizada, MLOps).

O que oferecemos:

• VR (Vale Refeição também para os dias de Home Office), VA e Gratificação de Férias no VR/VA.

• Assistência Médica, Odontológica e seguro de vida.

• PPR (Programa de Participação por Resultados)

• Flexibilidade: Modelo de trabalho híbrido com 3 dias em HO

• Bem-Estar: Wellhub (GymPass), frutas no escritório e o programa Elleva (acompanhamento de equipe multidisciplinar de nutricionista, educador físico e psicólogo), convênio farmácia e auxílio medicamentos para patologias graves.

• Licença maternidade 6 meses + Licença paternidade 20 dias (VR e VA durante todo o período)

• Auxílio creche até 6 anos

• Auxílio PCD para dependentes

• Plano de telefonia Arqia com descontos (Arqia4you)

• Vale-transporte, reembolso de estacionamento ou fretado.

• Reconhecimento: Prêmios por tempo de trabalho na empresa e reconhecimento por desempenho no trabalho.

• Incentivo ao desenvolvimento por meio de Bolsa de Estudos.

• Day off de aniversário e gratificação no Flash de aniversário.

title: Estágio Superior em Engenharia
description:
Fundada em 1916, a NSK é uma multinacional japonesa especializada na fabricação de rolamentos automotivos e industriais. Com presença global, a empresa se destaca por suas soluções de alta precisão, garantindo o funcionamento confiável de diversos sistemas. Comprometida com a inovação, investe em pesquisa e desenvolvimento e adota rigorosas políticas ambientais e de qualidade. Além de sua atuação industrial, a NSK valoriza a responsabilidade social e o bem-estar, promovendo iniciativas para a comunidade e o meio ambiente.

Estágio Superior em Engenharia — Suzano–SP — Presencial

A NSK está em busca de um(a) Estagiário(a) de Engenharia para apoiar atividades técnicas e operacionais, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de projetos, análises e melhorias contínuas. Se você é dinâmico(a), curioso(a) e busca aprendizado em um ambiente inovador e colaborativo, essa oportunidade é ideal para você!

Requisitos básicos:

  • Cursando Ensino Superior em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento intermediário no Pacote Office;
  • Inglês em nível básico

Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades:

  • Apoio na análise de falhas e na elaboração de relatórios técnicos;
  • Auxílio na validação dimensional de novos componentes;
  • Acompanhamento de testes dinâmicos e visitas técnicas na fábrica;
  • Suporte ao processo de gerenciamento de compras.

Diferencial:

• Conhecimento em Autocad ou Creo;

• Conhecimento em Power Bi

Benefícios: Refeição no local, vale alimentação, vale-transporte, seguro de vida, plano de saúde, Totalpass, PLR e mais!

title: Endocrinologista
description:
ENDOCRINOLOGISTA – Trabalho 100% Remoto!!

Venha construir a nova saúde digital com a Galileu!

A saúde está evoluindo, e a Galileu Saúde está na linha de frente dessa transformação.

Somos uma healthtech brasileira que une excelência clínica, tecnologia proprietária e cuidado humano para oferecer uma medicina mais acessível, eficiente e centrada no paciente.

Se você é ENDOCRINOLOGISTA e acredita que a inovação é o futuro da medicina, queremos você no nosso time!

title: Team Leader, B2B Sales
description:
Liderar a equipe para alcançar metas de negócios específicas e cumprir metas de desempenho atribuídas semanalmente/mensalmente/trimestralmente, garantindo alta satisfação do cliente.

Fornecer previsões de vendas contínuas e precisas e garantir que os dados registrados no CRM estejam exatos e atualizados.

Ser um facilitador para remover obstáculos e ajudar a equipe a resolver desafios para apoiar oportunidades de vendas.

Monitorar e impulsionar o tempo de chamada e a produtividade da equipe e conduzir análises de desempenho semanais e sessões de coaching semanais com todos os membros da equipe.

Analisar dados, desempenho e tendências de experiência do cliente para desenvolver estratégias de vendas e melhores práticas para clientes/territórios específicos.

Manter-se atualizado sobre os desenvolvimentos em serviços ao cliente e dentro do mercado e garantir que a equipe esteja informada sobre as últimas tendências e o mercado.

Ser um ponto de escalonamento para nossos clientes e responder prontamente a quaisquer problemas.

Manter um nível equilibrado de comunicação com o Diretor de Vendas e o cliente externo para garantir que o relacionamento estratégico com o cliente seja promovido e desenvolvido.

Trabalhar com o contato do cliente em relatórios e previsões.

Garantir que a equipe compreenda como alcançar as metas do plano operacional, metas de vendas e metas de desempenho do cliente (CPTs).

Trabalhar com o contato do cliente em relatórios e previsões.

Coordenar incentivos de equipe e Fundos de Incentivo de Desempenho de Vendas.

Estabelecer parcerias e construir relacionamentos de negócios com todos os parceiros para garantir que as expectativas dos clientes sejam atendidas.

Requisitos

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal em Espanhol ou Inglês (nível mínimo C1).

title: Programa de Formação de Novos Assessores
description:
Programa de Formação de Novos Assessores | EQI Investimentos

Você sonha em construir uma carreira sólida no mercado financeiro, transformar a vida das pessoas por meio dos investimentos e ter a chance de ser contratado pela empresa que mais cresce no mercado financeiro?

Aqui na EQI estamos com vagas abertas para o Programa de Formação de Novos Assessores.

Nosso programa é uma porta de entrada para quem busca não só uma certificação, mas também uma trilha de desenvolvimento estruturada para atuar como Assessor de Investimentos com alto desempenho.

O que é o Programa?

Certificação CPA-20

Fornecemos gratuitamente todo o material, suporte técnico e auxílio especializado para que você seja aprovado na certificação CPA-20, da ANBIMA — um dos requisitos para atuar como assessor.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando (preferência para cursos em áreas como Administração, Economia, Contabilidade, Engenharias ou afins);
  • Interesse real em construir carreira no mercado financeiro;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar de forma 100% presencial em Florianópolis;
  • Perfil proativo, comunicativo e com vontade de aprender;
  • Disponibilidade para dedicação durante o programa.

O que oferecemos:

  • Curso completo e gratuito preparatório para CPA-20;
  • Suporte e auxílio de especialistas durante todo o processo;
  • Possibilidade real de contratação como assessor ao final do programa;
  • Ambiente de muito aprendizado, networking e crescimento.

Como participar?

Se você está comprometido com sua evolução profissional e quer começar a trilhar um caminho de sucesso no mercado financeiro, inscreva-se agora !

title: Data Analyst
description:
Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Data Analyst. The Data Analyst will be responsible for analyzing and interpreting complex datasets, creating reports, and delivering actionable insights to support decision-making. Daily responsibilities include data modeling, performing statistical analysis, and visualizing data patterns and trends. The role also involves effective communication with team members and stakeholders to present findings and recommendations clearly.

Qualifications

  • Strong Analytical Skills and expertise in Data Analytics
  • Proficiency in Statistics and Data Modeling techniques
  • Excellent Communication skills for presenting data insights
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI is a plus
  • Familiarity with programming languages like Python or R is beneficial
  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred
  • Ability to work collaboratively and meet deadlines in remote settings

title: Analista de Sistemas Sênior - SRE
description:
Vem ser Ituber & vem fazer Itaú

O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 60 milhões de clientes em 18 países. Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um quadro com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças. É uma oportunidade com grandes desafios dado toda construção do sistema estar em uma plataforma com alto nível de modernização.

Atuação no modelo Hibrido no Metro Conceição em São Paulo zona sul

O que você precisa para ser um Ituber?

Estamos buscando pessoas que queiram se desenvolver e aprender constantemente, compartilhando, colaborando, inovando e entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes. Aqui a gente não sabe tudo, a gente vai de turma.

Como é o dia a dia de um Ituber nessa área?

Desenvolver e manter os serviços da plataforma

Garantir escalabilidade da plataforma

Garantir confiabilidade e desempenho da plataforma

Colaborar com outras equipes para compreender e atender às suas necessidades

Tecnologia: Golang , Kubernetes (especialmente EKS) , Técnicas SRE/DevOps (especialmente Observabilidade) , Infraestrutura AWS , Administração de sistemas Linux , Helm , GitOps (especialmente ArgoCD) , Container Design Patterns , Github Actions , Crossplane , OpenTelemetry

Desejável Certificação: AWS Solutions Architect , AWS EKS
